# Pi Remote Web

> A browser and phone UI for Pi coding-agent sessions running on a Mac. Install it as a Pi package, open sessions with `/remote-web`, or run it as a background service and pair a phone over Tailscale to follow and steer the agent away from your desk.

Pi owns the sessions, models, provider auth, tools, skills, and extensions; Pi Remote Web displays and drives them. The server only listens on `127.0.0.1`. Phones reach it through Tailscale Serve (HTTPS) and must be paired once with a QR code; pairing then lasts until revoked.

## Install

- `pi install <path-or-git-url>` adds the `/remote-web` command and the adapter that connects interactive Pi terminals to the background service. Requires Node.js 20+ and a working Pi.
- From a checkout, `npm install && npm link` puts the `pi-remote-web` CLI on PATH.

## Use inside Pi

- `/remote-web` opens the current session in the browser (live).
- `/remote-web <sessionId>` opens another session; `/remote-web open <sessionId> <port>` uses a custom port.
- `/remote-web stop` shuts it down.

## Phone access (background service, macOS)

1. `tailscale serve --bg --https=443 http://127.0.0.1:3847` publishes the port on your tailnet (use Serve, never Funnel).
2. `pi-remote-web install` installs and starts the LaunchAgent.
3. `pi-remote-web pair` prints a QR code and a five-minute single-use pairing link. Scan it inside the installed home-screen app (iOS keeps home-screen app cookies separate from Safari).

Other commands: `pi-remote-web status | doctor | logs | restart | stop | start | uninstall | revoke-all | help`. `pi-remote-web daemon` runs the server in the foreground.

Terminal sessions appear live once their Pi has the adapter loaded; a terminal started before installing it connects with `/reload`. Sessions owned by an unconnected terminal open as a read-only copy.

## Configuration

Environment variables:

- `PI_REMOTE_WEB_PORT` (default `3847`): HTTP port.
- `PI_REMOTE_WEB_PUBLIC_URL`: HTTPS URL accepted for pairing; detected from Tailscale Serve when unset.
- `PI_REMOTE_WEB_PI_BIN`: `pi` executable used for browser sessions; defaults to `pi` on PATH.
- `PI_REMOTE_WEB_SESSION_IDLE_MS` (default one day): close in-process sessions with no viewers; `0` disables.

Optional `~/.pi/agent/pi-remote-web/config.json` (a project's `.pi/pi-remote-web/config.json` applies once Pi trusts the project):

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "appearance": { "sidebarWidth": 360, "rightSidebarWidth": 360, "density": "comfortable" },
  "motion": { "intensity": "subtle" },
  "sound": { "enabled": true, "volume": 0.2, "turnComplete": "./sounds/complete.ogg" },
  "theme": { "accent": "#7c6cff", "radius": "0.6rem" }
}
```

Limits: sidebar widths 200–600 and 240–720 px; density compact, comfortable, or spacious; motion none, subtle, or full (reduced-motion settings win); volume 0–1; sounds are local `.ogg`, `.mp3`, or `.wav` paths relative to the config file; accent `#rrggbb`; radius in px or rem.
